target: Fenix bundled skill library; personal Codex skills and live service unchanged

decision.reason: Different inputs, outputs and permitted effects justify three directly discoverable procedures. Skill count alone is not evidence of agent quality.

method.baseline: Three new entries disabled; exact preceding parent entrypoints restored; all other embedded skills fixed within the paired test.
method.candidate: Known original parents upgraded with install_resources; three new entries enabled.
method.target_identity_change: The 18 positive cases target the former parent in the baseline and the specialist in the candidate. This measures access to the relevant procedure under each organization, not retrieval of an identical name.
method.negative_criterion: Each existing expected skill appears in top 3; none of the new skills appears in top 2 for the six neighboring cases.

Existing path confinement and installation tests

environment.reason: Concurrent server manifest changes did not match the workspace lockfile. Validation used an isolated snapshot.

compile_fix.reason: Concurrent importer called nix 0.30.1 renameat2 with None, which does not implement AsFd.
compile_fix.change: Pass the already-open root directory handle for each directory argument. Applied to workspace and snapshot.
compile_fix.scope: One call; no importer redesign or retrieval algorithm change.

environment.lock_timing_note: At the initial isolated check, seven dependency names were added to fenix-server in the copy; all package versions stayed fixed. By the final evidence check, concurrent workspace edits had made both lockfiles identical. This task did not write the workspace lockfile.

limitations: No live-model behavioral A/B evaluation was run.
No quality, latency, token or cost gain has been measured.
Queries are authored development checks; alias changes used observed failures.
Six neighboring requests cannot prove absence of all false triggers.
This does not establish 145 as an optimal or final number.
Validation covers the skill subsystem, not the entire concurrently modified application.
No live deployment or restart was performed; bundled resources require starting the updated binary.
